template.name: Mixed ecosystem
template.description: Many producers support a few foragers, mixotrophs, and predators. Survival depends on the food chain.

environment.name: Sunlit pond
environment.description: Light and minerals support producers; organic food comes from living cells and their remains.

populations.name: Phototroph
populations.description: Build a light harvester, then regulate the initiation of separate growth and division machinery.

populations.name: Forager
populations.description: Share product stocks between food storage, digestion and motors; navigate using named physical receptors.

populations.name: Mixotroph
populations.description: Share materials between light harvesting and a separately regulated feeding pathway.

populations.name: Predator
populations.description: Approach visible objects with a named eye, then use a placed piercer and separate engulfment machinery.

rateDefinitions.upkeep: Body maintenance before temperature scaling; excludes the extra 0.15 ATP/s per area basal cost.
rateDefinitions.metabolism: Complete basal maintenance at local temperature; motor, weapon, construction and repair costs are additional.
rateDefinitions.digestionRate: Usable energy gained per simulated second after substrate conversion losses.
